Course Description:

Learn the art and architecture of the Fault Line Cake, the bold, modern cake design that blends raw edges with polished precision. This eye-catching style is more than just a trend. It's a versatile canvas that allows cake artists to showcase texture, movement, and creativity in limitless ways.

In this hands-on class, you’ll master the structural techniques behind a Fault Line Cake. From edible images and metallic finishes to floral illusions, the Fault Line Cake can be tailored for birthdays, weddings, brand launches, and everything in between.

Whether you're a home baker, an established cake designer, or a culinary creative looking to grow your portfolio, this course gives you more than just skills. It gives you a blueprint for artistic freedom. Break the rules. Break the mold. And still build something beautiful.

What’s Included in the Class

Whether you’re joining us online or in person, this class is fully loaded with everything you need to build bold, beautiful Fault Line Cakes with confidence and style.

The Cake

  • Cake Layers, ganache and buttercream 
  • Hands-on construction and decorating guidance from Titi Adelayo
  • Option to tailor your design style: rustic, glam, floral, playful—your cake, your vibe

Essential Tools (provided in class or linked for online students)

  • The Profroster – our MVP for clean lines and sculpted edges
  • Cake turntable
  • Cake boards
  • Offset spatula and bench scraper
  • Piping bags, palette knife, and angled brush
  • Gel colors, edible gold, sprinkles, and edible images to bring your fault line to life

Digital Goodies

  • A curated PDF library of edible image designs, including florals, cartoons, textures, foil illusions, and more

products.title: Graduation Cake Masterclass
products.body_html:
Celebrate Big Milestones with Even Bigger Cakes

This masterclass is all about bold statements, clean lines, and unforgettable details. Designed for decorators who want to elevate their graduation cake game, this class teaches you how to build stylish, impactful cakes that capture the energy and emotion of one of life’s biggest moments.

We’ll walk through how to create graduation-themed cakes that feel both modern and personal—whether you're working with school colors, diploma scrolls, cap toppers, or luxury textures like stenciling, metallic accents, or edible images. You’ll learn how to make your designs versatile enough for kindergarten grads, high school seniors, and college graduates alike.

This isn’t just about piping a “Congratulations” on top. It’s about making cakes that feel like a celebration in themselves.

What You’ll Learn:

  • How to design layered graduation cakes with structure and wow-factor
  • Clean stacking and sharp edges for that polished look
  • Working with school colors, photo toppers, edible images, and themed décor
  • How to incorporate caps, scrolls, and bling without it looking cheesy
  • Fast upgrades: easy ways to make a simple cake look premium
  • Photography tips to showcase your work and boost bookings during grad season

This class is perfect for bakers prepping for graduation season rush or anyone who wants to confidently offer next-level grad cakes that stand out in a sea of sheet cakes.

Free Fire – Featuring intense battleground details, weapon icons, or your favorite in-game characters, this cake is perfect for gamers who love survival and strategy.
Dragon Ball – Power up the celebration with Goku, Vegeta, or the legendary Dragon Balls, capturing the electrifying energy of Saiyan warriors.
One Piece – Set sail with Luffy and the Straw Hat Pirates, featuring pirate flags, Devil Fruits, and the spirit of adventure on the Grand Line.
